resource_policy.on_regression: Terminate observation process group only; no automatic retry

precision: BF16 dense; W2 numerical weights, no INT2 kernel performance claim
attention: eager; matches original native export probe reference

figure2.scope: main256 per domain; original pilot retained unchanged

entropy.eligible: completion tokens only, shifted next-token targets; no EOS, no prompt or padding
entropy.primary: state-cluster-bootstrap Low minus High (log_tail_Q - log_tail_T), no epsilon
entropy.truncation: Reject whole overlength pairs; never splice or truncate completion. Report eligible population and length confounding.
entropy.prompt: Pinned PromptManage.chat_template_to_prompt([user=input], qwen), preserving full provided proof/state/retrieval; no new retrieval queries for samples
entropy.numeric_precision: BF16 model; FP64 full-vocabulary statistics with max-shift and log1p normalization
entropy.threshold_freeze: Recompute on same disjoint calibration states with corrected FP64 entropy before W2; old thresholds retained for audit only

parity.reason: Validate dense runtime against SHA-verified original native probe on exact original 16 prefixes; no self-parity or new native package install

formal_results: WAITING_FINAL_EVAL; never select observations or thresholds from theorem outcomes
